messages:
diane-security: FYI launching a limited preview: Ephemeral Support Shell (ESS) for Private/VPC/on-prem customers.

Quick bullets:
- Opt-in only via Console. Default OFF.
- Ephemeral tokens, default TTL 1h (customer-configurable up to 8h).
- Full session audit to customer audit sink; no persistent access.
- Requires agent v4.0.1+ (preview gate).
- Preview = Enterprise+ accounts only while we finish compliance attestation.

Rollout: canary agent 2026-04-01, preview invites 2026-04-07, audit review by 2026-05-01. Docs + RFC linked in internal wiki.

ajay-prod: Any auto-opt-ins?

diane-security: No, invites only. SEs to coordinate.

leo-sre: Network footprint? inbound ports?
diane-security: No inbound. Agent opens outbound TLS 443 to support.redwood.ai. Air-gapped gets offline bundle/audit artifact.

maria-ps: Need sales one-pager with compliance bullets.
diane-security: On it, will share checklist + invite spreadsheet by EOD.

devex-bot: Draft release note: Agent v4.0.1: ESS (preview) - support handshake, session audit hooks, token TTL. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/agent/pull/4821
oncall-bot: Canary deploy windows: dogfood 2026-04-01 03:00 UTC; wider canary 2026-04-02 09:00 UTC.

diane-security: Ping me for preview cohort interest or blockers.
